data.name: Hawaiian Foodie Bike Tour
data.headline: 4 Hours + • Taste Hawaii • Tuesday through Sunday 1:00 pm
data.description:
#Taste Hawaii!

Meet at the Kuhio Beach Banyan Tree, Waikiki Beach at 1:00 pm.  After your bike fitting and safety instructions, we ride through Kapiolani Park and learn its history.  We visit our State fish in nature our Humuhumunukunukuapuaa, "Hawaii State fish", then head on to experience 6+ different foodie favorites on the outskirts of Waikiki. We will eat at 5-6 stops.  

 These World Famous Kaimuki-Kapahulu local diners offer a taste of Hawaii never to be found by most visitors.  We ride about 25-minutes before heading to one of several local diners (specifically chosen by your guide based on your personal tastes). You'll eat fresh homemade local food;  Snack on Malasada donuts with photoshoots at every location. Grab a menu at each of our stops and learn about the history of the locations and neighborhoods as we go. 

Best of all we enjoy the day to the fullest while giving your pallet something to associate your experience in Paradise with! This is a fun foodie tour with healthy cycling activity is a perfect combination. Food/drinks and snacks included.  Mostly flat terrain, Tour ride 5 – 7 miles.  (4 hrs +)  Customization tour options are available.
